name: Backspace over every cell removes the table, leaving one empty line
Delete over every cell removes the table, leaving one empty line
a selection to the point in an empty last cell covers every cell
a short last row's last existing cell is its last cell; a table at the note's start
a header-only table is covered by its header's cells
a table at the note's end with no line ending
ends inside formatted cells, at the edges of their visible text, cover them
a CRLF table leaves its last line's CRLF
a table under a code block goes alone
an end above the table stays; the end in the table goes to its line's end
an end below the table stays; the end in the table goes to its line's start
an end on a list item above the table stays
typing over every cell replaces the table's lines
a text service's text over every cell replaces the table's lines
marked text committed over every cell replaces the table's lines
a selection one cell short at the start deletes as plain text
a selection one cell short at the end deletes as plain text
a selection inside a one-cell table's only cell deletes that cell's text
